# Imposter World

> Imposter World is a free multiplayer imposter word game to play online with friends. Players get a secret word, give clues (text, drawing or voice), debate in chat and vote to find the imposter.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://imposter-world.onrender.com/): Create or join a room
- [How to Play](https://imposter-world.onrender.com/how-to-play): Rules and steps
- [Articles](https://imposter-world.onrender.com/articles): Strategy and guides

## Modes
- Play with Friends: private link rooms
- Local Pass & Play: one phone
- Instant Match
- Tournament

## Notes
- Free browser-based party game, no download or install required.
- Supports 3 to 14 players per room across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
